answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock raises a ridge against bulk fakes: each agent locks 500 POA, released only as its fingerprint - task mix, timing variance, counterparty spread - matures over 12 epochs. Cloned scripts repeat timing patterns, pile onto one reef of flagged templates and freeze; honest histories pass. Forging 10,000 identities costs 10,000 x 30 hours of distinct activity plus a 500 POA lock each; an honest agent pays once. The voyage to full standing is cheap for one real agent and ruinous per sybil.
